minimalist-dot.label: Minimalist dot
minimalist-dot.summary: py-10 header with terracotta dot-in-circle logo, inline nav links, active link uses font-bold border-b border-[#D97757]

boxed-icon.label: Boxed icon header
boxed-icon.summary: py-5 header with rounded-square icon tile, label + serif brand, nav rendered as pill (bg-[#E6E4D9]/70)

gradient-gb-circle.label: Gradient "gb" circle (PRD style)
gradient-gb-circle.summary: Inline-style header with gradient circle showing italic 'gb' text — no nav, max-w-5xl container

none.label: No site header
none.summary: Page provides its own hero (VideoHero) or has no chrome

pages.title: Home
pages.notes: Composes VideoHero + Portfolio + TechMarquee + Features + Process + Pricing + ContactForm + Footer. Canonical brand surface.

pages.title: Login
pages.notes: Hosts AWS Amplify Authenticator. Header uses ArrowLeft+text, simpler than Ops/Portal but matches the py-5 boxed-icon family.

pages.title: PRD Index
pages.notes: Heavy inline-style usage rather than Tailwind utilities. Container is max-w-5xl (smaller than the rest of the site which uses max-w-7xl).

pages.title: PRD View
pages.notes: Renders embedded PRD HTML inside glass-panel. Back-link only, no shared chrome.

pages.title: Plan
pages.notes: Just wraps PRDGenerator — no site header or footer. Often linked from minimalist-dot nav as 'Plan', but the page itself has no nav.

pages.title: Apps
pages.notes: Active link styled with bottom border. Hosts AppsGallery.

pages.title: Artifacts
pages.notes: Adds Archive sub-link to the nav. Hosts RegistryArtifacts + ArtifactsGallery.

pages.title: Blockers
pages.notes: Live mirror of blockers.md via AppSync.

pages.title: YouTube Intel
pages.notes: App tool. Uses Metric cards with brand tokens.

pages.title: Mall Scanner
pages.notes: App tool. Mirrors YouTubeIntel layout/metric pattern.

pages.title: UI Agent
pages.notes: This auditor. Loads the gbautomation brand spec and renders this inventory + audit findings.

pages.title: Ops Overview
pages.notes: Operations dashboard. Header lives in OpsHeader.jsx, no footer.

pages.title: JID5274 Portal
pages.notes: Per-tenant portal; uses the boxed-icon family. Verify visual parity with PortalHeader.

uniformityFindings.title: Three distinct header families compete for the same brand voice
uniformityFindings.detail: minimalist-dot (Apps/Artifacts/Blockers/Plan-nav), boxed-icon (Ops/Portal/Login), gradient-gb-circle (PRDs). Each implies a different identity. A first-time visitor crossing from /apps to /ops to /prds sees three brand presentations.
uniformityFindings.recommendation: Consolidate to a single shared header component (e.g. src/components/PageHeader.jsx). Promote the boxed-icon variant as the surface for tools (Ops, Portal, Apps, Artifacts, Blockers, UI Agent) and reserve the gradient-gb-circle for marketing/PRD reading surfaces only — and even there, align typography and container width with the rest of the site.

uniformityFindings.title: Inconsistent main container widths
uniformityFindings.detail: Most pages use max-w-7xl px-6 py-16. PRD pages use max-w-5xl px-4 py-12. Blockers uses max-w-4xl px-6 py-16.
uniformityFindings.recommendation: Standardize on max-w-7xl for dashboard/tool routes; reserve narrower max-w-3xl for long-form text (Blockers markdown). Codify in a Layout primitive.

uniformityFindings.title: Footer presence is inconsistent across gated routes
uniformityFindings.detail: Home/Apps/Artifacts/Blockers/YouTubeIntel/MallScanner render <Footer />; Ops and client portals do not. Plan/Login/PRD routes omit it intentionally.
uniformityFindings.recommendation: Decide per surface family. For tool surfaces (Ops, Portal), keep no footer but add a slim status strip (build sha, env). For consumer surfaces, keep the full Footer.

uniformityFindings.title: PRDIndex/PRDView use heavy inline styles in lieu of Tailwind tokens
uniformityFindings.detail: Buttons and badges in PRDIndex.jsx are constructed via pillStyle(color) inline. Hard to keep in sync with palette changes.
uniformityFindings.recommendation: Extract status/wave/priority pills into a <Pill kind="status|wave|priority" value={...} /> component that reads from the brand JSON published at /ui-agent/gbautomation-brand.json.

uniformityFindings.title: Cross-surface navigation is uneven
uniformityFindings.detail: Apps header offers Apps/Artifacts/Plan; Artifacts adds Archive; Blockers adds Blockers. None of the minimalist-dot headers expose YouTubeIntel, MallScanner, UI Agent, Ops, or Portal — making them effectively undiscoverable.
uniformityFindings.recommendation: Move the nav into a single source of truth (e.g. an array exported from src/lib/navigation.js) consumed by every header. Group by surface family with visual separators.

uniformityFindings.title: Heading styles vary between font-serif font-medium and inline italic Newsreader
uniformityFindings.detail: Most pages use Tailwind's font-serif font-medium. PRD pages override with inline-style italic Newsreader.
uniformityFindings.recommendation: If italic is intentional for PRDs, add a `.font-serif-display-italic` utility in index.css and use it. Otherwise normalize to font-serif font-medium tracking-tight.

uniformityFindings.title: Tree/branch coverage vs. ui-agents trees.yaml
uniformityFindings.detail: ui-agents/apps/infinite-ui/src/brands/gbautomation/products/site/trees.yaml declares trees: hero, portfolio, features, process, pricing, testimonials, contact, about, blog, calculator. The live site has hero, portfolio, features, process, pricing, contact. Missing: testimonials, about, blog, calculator.
uniformityFindings.recommendation: Either drop the empty branches from trees.yaml or schedule generation runs to fill in testimonials/about/blog/calculator using the UI Generation Team.
